Evaluate Multiomics Integration & Cross-Modal Alignment Fidelity (Category VI)

Source: R/07_multiomics_coupling.R
evaluate_multiomics_integration.Rd

Evaluates the multiomics integration and cross-modal alignment fidelity of simulated single-cell multiomics data across 5 gold-standard integration metrics extracted from key single-cell benchmarking suites (scib, scMultiSim, scCross, Matilda, and scMoMtF):

  1. Batch ASW (batch_asw): Average Silhouette Width evaluating batch mixing within cell types (scib, scMultiSim).

  2. Cell-Type ASW (cell_type_asw): Average Silhouette Width evaluating cell-type bio-conservation in the multiomics space (scCross, scib).

  3. Graph Connectivity (graph_connectivity): Relative size of the largest connected component in the k-NN graph for each cell type (scCross, scMultiSim, scib).

  4. ARI (ari): Adjusted Rand Index comparing joint multiomics clustering against ground-truth cell types (scib, scCross, scMultiSim, Matilda, scMoMtF).

  5. NMI (nmi): Normalized Mutual Information quantifying information concordance between joint clustering and cell types (scib, scCross, scMultiSim, Matilda, scMoMtF).

Usage

evaluate_multiomics_integration(
  ref_multi = NULL,
  sim_multi,
  cell_types = NULL,
  batch_info = NULL,
  embed = NULL,
  reduction_name = NULL,
  n_pcs = 15,
  k = 30,
  threads = 1,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

ref_multi

Optional reference multiomics list of matrices (e.g. list(rna = ..., atac = ...)).

sim_multi

Simulated multiomics list of matrices or a matrix representing joint embedding coordinates.

cell_types

Optional cell-type vector or list/data.frame of annotations for each cell.

batch_info

Optional batch/donor/replicate vector or list/data.frame of annotations for each cell.

embed

Optional precomputed joint embedding matrix (cells x dimensions). If NULL, computed automatically from sim_multi.

reduction_name

Optional name of the precomputed dimensional reduction to extract from Seurat/SCE objects.

n_pcs

Number of principal components per modality to retain for joint embedding (default 15).

k

Number of nearest neighbors for graph-based metrics (default 30).

threads

Number of CPU threads for parallel processing (default 1).

verbose

Logical; whether to print progress messages (default TRUE).

Value

A list of class scSimEval_integration containing:

metrics

Named list of the 5 calculated integration metric values (batch_asw, cell_type_asw, graph_connectivity, ari, nmi).

integration_summary_table

A tidy data.frame containing the 5 metrics with columns Category, Property, Metric, Value, and Modality.

embedding

The joint multiomics embedding matrix used for evaluation.

Examples

data(example_multiomics, package = "scSimEval")
ct <- rep(c("A", "B"), each = 50)
res <- evaluate_multiomics_integration(sim_multi = example_multiomics$sim_multi, cell_types = ct)
#> Using precomputed dimensional reduction from sim_multi for Category VI.
